behaviors: Every frozen operator command parses and reaches a real handler through the shared registration seam
Duplicate core command registration fails during parser construction
Success and failure output obey the frozen JSON and exit-code contract
The runtime wheel contains no Build Fabric tooling, state, browser/provider implementation, or helios-build entry point
Existing helios-p0, helios-p1a, and helios-engine entry points remain exact
Build Fabric source has no runtime database imports or P0/P1A table authority
The README documents finite local and external operation without claiming unavailable providers

capability: Complete the repository Build Fabric operator CLI, documentation, package exclusion, and authority boundary.

block.action: Block acceptance until package exclusion is proven.
block.when: The clean wheel includes Build Fabric code, state, or an entry point.

escalation.action: Escalate for task split or redesign without another blind test loop.
escalation.when: Two substantive correction rounds do not satisfy the frozen acceptance behavior.

reroute.action: Create an explicit successor task and assignment; never relabel another worker's output.
reroute.when: The identified external builder cannot complete the bounded task.

stop.action: Stop the task and reject the patch.
stop.when: The patch imports runtime authority code or changes P0/P1A data surfaces.

deliverables: A working repository-local Build Fabric CLI
Operator documentation for finite execution and evidence custody
Proof that Build Fabric code and state are excluded from the runtime wheel
Proof that Build Fabric cannot import or write P0/P1A authority surfaces
frozen_interfaces: python -m tools.helios_build external-session begin TASK --worker-profile PROFILE --provider PROVIDER --session-id SESSION --role BUILDER|REVIEWER --routing-reason REASON
python -m tools.helios_build external-session import-handoff TASK --assignment SHA --handoff PATH --patch PATH --raw-evidence PATH
python -m tools.helios_build external-session import-review TASK --assignment SHA --review PATH --raw-evidence PATH
Exit codes: 0 success, 2 contract or usage, 3 blocked or unavailable, 4 failed, 5 outcome unknown
All stdout is compact sorted JSON and all errors are compact structured JSON on stderr
